name: FND_NTF_EVENT
description: Entity for persisting business events received from all registered ApplicationModules.

columns.name: EVENT_VERSION
columns.description: 0 based version column for tracking subsequent change requests on top of the original event-id row.

columns.name: APP_MODULE_ID
columns.description: Foreign key referencing the fnd_ntf_application_module table.

columns.name: CLOUD_EVENT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the business event as specified by the producer ApplicationModule.

columns.name: CLOUD_EVENT_TYPE
columns.description: Event Type of the business event as specified by the producer ApplicationModule.

columns.name: CLOUD_EVENT_SOURCE
columns.description: Event Source of the business event as specified by the producer ApplicationModule.

columns.name: DATA_CONTENT_TYPE
columns.description: Mine-type of the payload of the business event.

columns.name: CHANNEL_TYPE
columns.description: The name for the channel as registered in fnd_ntf_channel table.

columns.name: PROCESSING_HINTS_JSON
columns.description: JSON (versioned) configuration specifying the application layer tuning parameters chosen for fine grained control of how this business event is precoessed.

columns.name: DATA
columns.description: The actual payload to be delivered to the outbound channel(s).

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
